mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user ( id, uid, email, password_hash, status, group_code, email_verified, activated_at, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{uid}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{statusCode}, #{groupCode}, #{emailVerified}, #{activatedAt}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET email = #{email}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, status = #{statusCode}, group_code = #{groupCode}, email_verified = #{emailVerified}, activated_at = #{activatedAt}, last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT kyc_level FROM t_user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET email = COALESCE(#{email}, email), email_verified = COALESCE(#{emailVerified}, email_verified), group_code = COALESCE(#{groupCode}, group_code), kyc_level = COALESCE(#{kycLevel}, kyc_level), status = COALESCE(#{statusCode}, status) WHERE id = #{userId}
